payload.title: The runner's role reaches only gated operations
payload.description:
The runner's role may call every Query and Mutation field of a site's API today. Narrow it to the gated operation mutations and the reads agents need, so that even a faulty tool cannot write around the gate. The model key stays in SSM, read by the runner process and never given to the model; channel secrets stay write-only as today.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A direct model mutation from the runner's role is refused by IAM.
- Every agent still works through the gate.
- No secret appears in a run record or a prompt.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- runner-least-privilege.feature: a raw update from the runner role is refused; the gated operation succeeds; a run record contains no key material.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** Runner template: IAM policy narrowed (a pipeline-roles change: needs approval after merge).

**Part of:** Authorization: the autonomy ladder as configuration. Slice code E3 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
